name: Local movers
summary: How expats book local movers in Singapore — man-and-van vs full crews, condo lift bookings, disposal add-ons, and peak-month pricing.
body:
Local movers handle unit-to-unit shifts, storage runs, and partial loads when you are not doing a full international relocation. Condo lift bookings and padding rules often drive the timeline more than distance.

## Decision points
- Man-and-van vs full packing crew
- Lift booking / protection deposit with MCST
- Disposal / donation runs vs keep-all moves
- Peak month and weekend surcharges
- Insurance for high-value items

Share floor plans and photos of bulky sofas early.

## How to choose
Prefer movers who itemise labour hours, transport, and materials. Ask about waiting-time fees when lifts run late. Confirm whether dismantling beds/wardrobes is included.

## Practical tip
Book the condo lift before you book the truck. Crews idle expensive when the loading bay is free but the lift is not.
